paragraphs: On Wednesday, Tom and Lily came home from school at four o'clock. Mom was not at home, and the house was very quiet. Pip ran to the door and jumped. There was a note on the fridge. It was from Mom.

"Dear Tom and Lily, I went to Green Hill to see Grandma. She called me this morning, and she needs help in her garden. I took the three o'clock bus. Grandma has a lot of work in the garden, and I want to help her. I looked at the bus timetable. The last bus from Green Hill leaves at half past five. The bus takes half an hour, so I will be home at six o'clock.

Dad agrees with me: you can have a snack. There is rice and soup in the fridge. But zero TV before homework, please! Dad will come home at seven o'clock, and we will eat dinner together. I am sure that you can do it. Please feed Pip at five o'clock. His red ball has disappeared again. Do you mind looking for it? Love, Mom"

Tom and Lily read the note two times. "Mom's note is very easy to read," said Tom. They did their homework first. At five o'clock, Lily fed Pip, and he drank some water. Then Tom looked under the sofa, but the ball was not there. Lily found it behind a cushion. Pip was very happy, and he ran around the room. "Pip always loses his ball," said Lily with a laugh.

Lily wrote a short note and put it on the fridge. "Dear Mom, We agree about the TV. We have already done our homework. We fed Pip at five o'clock, and we found his ball. It was behind a cushion! How is Grandma? Please tell Grandma that we send her a big hug. See you at six o'clock. Love, Tom and Lily"
text.summary: Tom and Lily find a note from Mom on the fridge. The note tells the time and the place, and the children do what Mom asks and write a note to answer her.
